# The lamp's two beams: 4-sided pyramids 5 m long, apex at the lamp (0, 0, 3.76 in the lighthouse's
# frame), 0.9 m across at the far end, pointing +X and -X; they turn with the lamp head (8 s a turn,
# linear, clockwise from above: the same keys as lighthouse/p2_form.txt). Unlit splats, stippled towards the tips. Up Z.
new
fps 24
frame range 0 192
add mesh cone --name BeamA --vertices 4 --radius1 0.65 --radius2 0 --depth 5 --location 2.5 0 3.76 --rotation 0 -90 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cone --name BeamB --vertices 4 --radius1 0.65 --radius2 0 --depth 5 --location -2.5 0 3.76 --rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
material new Beam --base-color 1 1 1 --emission 0.941 0.965 0.941
material texture Beam base-color beam_stipple.png
material set Beam alpha-mode mask
material set Beam alpha-cutoff 0.5
select BeamA BeamB
material assign Beam
active BeamA
join
# the stipple texture (beam_texture.py) laid over both beams from above: u runs tip to tip along X
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
rename BeamA Beam
cursor set 0 0 3.76
origin set --to cursor
shade flat
select Beam
set rotation 0 0 0
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 0
set rotation 0 0 -360
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 192
keyframe interpolation linear --all
frame set 0
export beam.glb --bake-animations
